courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring instruments through transferable principles, measurements and validation; a link does not imply the same vendor, generation or acceptance requirements.

related.title: 超穎透鏡製程研究
related.transfer: 可遷移「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」與「浮雕量測與繞射級功率分佈」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；超穎透鏡製程研究的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" and "Relief metrology and diffraction-order power distribution" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Metalens fabrication research must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以純量繞射效率、相位階數與蝕刻深度控制，把微影製作的繞射元件做到可驗收的效率與零級洩漏；超穎透鏡製程研究則以從超穎原子相位庫到 EBL／DUV 曝光、高深寬比蝕刻與聚焦效率驗收的平面透鏡製程工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on bringing lithographically made diffractive elements to acceptable efficiency and zero-order leakage through scalar efficiency, phase-level count and etch-depth control; Metalens fabrication research centres on from meta-atom phase libraries to EBL/DUV exposure, high-aspect-ratio etching and focusing-efficiency acceptance of flat lenses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「2π 相位摺疊與 M 階階梯」與「雙曲相位剖面與取樣格點」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。
把本課算例的一個假設移到超穎透鏡製程研究，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「色差、景深與消色差極限」為例，設計一項能區分兩種系統的驗證量測，並註明不確定度。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “2π phase wrapping and the M-level staircase” and “Hyperbolic phase profile and sampling lattice”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Metalens fabrication research, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Chromatic shift, depth of focus and achromatic limits", design a verification measurement that distinguishes the two systems and state its uncertainty.

references.scopeEn: Publicly lists each MUSE spectrograph as collimator, volume phase holographic grating and camera, covering 480–930 nm with resolving power about 1770 to 3590; a reference for volume gratings in a real astronomical instrument.

references.title: HORIBA：刻劃式與全像式繞射光柵技術頁

references.scopeEn: Explains that holographic gratings are exposed with two-beam laser interference fringes, have no ghosts because there are no periodic ruling errors, show lower stray light, reach 6000 lines/mm and can be ion-etched to laminar profiles; no process parameters.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 繞射光學元件製作
history.text: 1875 年 Soret 製作了 Fresnel 波帶片，1969 年 IBM 的 Lesem、Hirsch 與 Jordan 提出以 2π 摺疊相位的 kinoform，1971 年 Dammann 發表二元相位分束光柵。1980 年代 MIT 林肯實驗室的 Veldkamp 與 Swanson 提出「二元光學」，以多道光罩與離子蝕刻製作多階繞射元件並建立 sinc² 效率理論，1989 年的技術報告成為此領域的標準參考；1990 年代後，繞射元件進入雷射光束整形、光譜儀與消費相機的混合折射繞射鏡頭，奈米壓印與灰階直寫則把它推向量產與連續輪廓。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: Soret made Fresnel zone plates in 1875; Lesem, Hirsch and Jordan at IBM introduced the kinoform with 2π-wrapped phase in 1969; Dammann published binary-phase splitting gratings in 1971. In the 1980s Veldkamp and Swanson at MIT Lincoln Laboratory introduced binary optics, making multilevel diffractive elements with multiple masks and ion etching and establishing the sinc² efficiency theory, and their 1989 technical report became the field's standard reference; from the 1990s diffractive elements entered laser beam shaping, spectrometers and hybrid refractive-diffractive camera lenses, while nanoimprint and grayscale writing carried them to volume production and continuous profiles. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「純量繞射、相位量化與效率」到「規格定義、保護帶與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Scalar diffraction, phase quantisation and efficiency" through "Specification definition, guard band and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.

roles.roleEn: Public information on diffractive elements in camera lenses and nanoimprint equipment
roles.business: 影像與半導體設備製造商，在相機鏡頭中使用多層繞射光學元件，並供應奈米壓印微影設備。
roles.businessEn: Imaging and semiconductor-equipment maker that uses multilayer diffractive optical elements in camera lenses and supplies nanoimprint lithography systems.

courses.connection: 從「繞射光學元件製作」的元件、量測或系統整合延伸到下列廠商與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購或背書。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the components, measurements or system integration of Diffractive optical-element fabrication. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement or endorsement.

vendors.name: Holo/Or
vendors.business: 以色列繞射光學元件製造商，以微影與電漿蝕刻在熔融石英與 ZnSe 上製作光束整形器、分束器與繞射透鏡。
vendors.businessEn: Israeli diffractive-optics maker producing beam shapers, splitters and diffractive lenses in fused silica and ZnSe by lithography and plasma etching.

vendors.name: Jenoptik
vendors.business: 光學系統與精密光學元件製造商，提供從紫外到紅外的光學鍍膜與鍍膜光學元件。
vendors.businessEn: Maker of optical systems and precision optical components, offering optical coatings and coated optics from ultraviolet to infrared.

vendors.name: 蘇斯微技術
vendors.business: 光罩對準曝光機、壓印微影與晶圓製程設備製造商，供應多階繞射元件所需的套準曝光與奈米壓印設備。
vendors.businessEn: Maker of mask aligners, imprint lithography and wafer-processing equipment supplying the overlay exposure and nanoimprint tools used for multilevel diffractive elements.

vendors.name: 佳能
vendors.business: i-line 與 KrF 半導體微影設備及奈米壓印設備。
vendors.businessEn: i-line and KrF semiconductor lithography equipment and nanoimprint systems.
